levers.intro_1: Where the Grease Cost Actually Sits
levers.formula: Grease cost per component = (grams applied × price per kg) / 1000
levers.intro_2: Which means there are only three places the money can be found — and only one of them is a price negotiation.

items.title: Price per kilogram
items.description: Removing imported freight, duty, distributor margins, and currency risk by formulating and manufacturing in India to the exact approved specification.

items.title: Grams applied per component
items.description: Reducing over-application through accurate dispensing guidance, rheology optimization, and correct grease placement at assembly.

items.title: Inventory and working capital
items.description: Eliminating 2-to-4-month import lead times, reducing buffer stock requirements, and freeing working capital tied up in shop-floor drums.

levers.closing: MOSIL works on all three. Most suppliers only discuss the first.

faq.q: My component is already in production with an approved imported grease. Can we change it?
faq.a: Yes. Component OEMs routinely re-validate or multi-source greases when a domestic supplier demonstrates compliance with the original OEM specification sheet. MOSIL provides full technical data and test reports to support your internal and OEM re-validation process.

faq.q: What if we don't have the full OEM grease specification sheet?
faq.a: That is common. MOSIL's TriboIntel laboratory can analyze your current grease sample to establish its base oil type, viscosity, thickener system, additive package, and key performance parameters.

faq.q: Will changing grease affect our component warranty or OEM approval?
faq.a: Not if the change is executed correctly. Re-validation against the OEM spec ensures component performance remains within approved design limits. MOSIL does not recommend changeovers without proper specification matching and validation.

faq.q: How long does a typical CPC reduction project take from diagnostic to line supply?
faq.a: Timing depends on the validation depth required. Lab matching and proposal: 1-2 weeks. Plant trialing and initial validation: 4-8 weeks. Full OEM sign-off (if required): varies by OEM process.

faq.q: Is our component and volume information kept confidential?
faq.a: Yes. All diagnostic inputs are strictly confidential, handled only by MOSIL application engineers, and never shared externally or used in marketing without explicit written consent.
